messages.content: Your order usually arrives within 2-3 business days.
Yes. Eligible products can be returned within 7 days of delivery.
Yes. You can cancel your order before it is shipped.
How can I track my order?
You can track your order using the tracking link sent to your registered email.
What if my product arrives damaged?
Please contact customer support within 48 hours and share a photo of the damaged product.
Do you offer cash on delivery?
Yes. Cash on delivery is available for eligible orders.
How can I contact customer support?
You can contact our support team through email or phone during business hours.
Refunds are processed after the returned product is received and approved.
